Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

opamr 0.1.0

  • First release.
  • Crosswalk between antimicrobial names, AMR codes, ATC codes and BNF chemical codes: ab_to_bnf(), bnf_to_ab(), atc_to_bnf(), bnf_to_atc(), op_antibiotics(), bnf_level(), bnf_parent(), bnf_class(). The bundled antibiotic_crosswalk table has 121 BNF chemicals.
  • OpenPrescribing client: op_spending(), op_spending_ab(), op_org_details(), op_rate(), op_antibiotic_use(), op_bnf_search(), op_org_search(), op_check_api(), op_cache_clear(). It caches responses (in memory and optionally on disk), limits the request rate and retries transient errors.
  • Figures: op_plot_trend(), op_plot_seasonal(), op_plot_distribution(), op_plot_heatmap(), theme_op(), scale_colour_op(), op_palette(), op_save().
  • Example data: op_example, national monthly antibacterial prescribing from November 2020 to June 2026.
  • Four vignettes, a pkgdown site, unit tests, visual-regression tests (vdiffr) and optional live-API tests.

Developed by Package Maintainer.

Site built with pkgdown 2.2.1.
